nom: Buttah Skin Charcoal Detox Face Mask

avis.texte: I love this product. It always makes my skin feel cleansed and refreshed.

avis.titre: I would probably not buy it again
avis.texte: It was very small and cost a lot of money. It also burns my face and leaves it feeling dry. The product is hard to completely scrub off and leaves a mess in the sink. It does have a nice cooling feeling while it is on though.
Perfect for hydrating and detoxification for skin. Pairs perfectly with the Buttah moisturizing face cream! Great product!
A little goes a long way, with visible results. I use once or twice a week reset my routine.

I had it less than 3 months and it dried up completely. Only got to use it two times. I am hesitant to purchase another. The results weren't dramatic enough because I didn't get consistent use. Slowly tried to introduce it and it didn't make the cut

Im confused on some of these reviews I never have experienced any type of burning sensation. For those who are saying it broke them out. Ummm its a detox mask that what happens when the product is working. I mean how else do you expect your skin to act when its detoxing, it has to be released somehow and thats with pimples. Including whiteheads. But i love the product it makes my skin super soft and brighter.

avis.titre: I love it! Gentle; delivers radiant skin w/ no tightness
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin and sever allergies to some preservatives in cosmetics. Although I am 50 and post menopausal, I still have slightly oily, clog prone skin. This simple formula seemed like it would be safe when I checked the ingredients. I couldn't believe how soft, smooth, and radiant my skin looked after the first use. I was hoping it would help address the clogged pores on my chin that even topical prescriptions can't seem to keep clear. Now, I can't imagine being without this. I experienced no irritation or dryness whatsoever from this formula. It's so gentle. I hope they keep making this for a long time. I don't want to be without it!
Mask came off easy after the recommended ten minutes and left my skin so smooth and feels really clean.
My go to skincare products. I have sensitive skin and can't use a lot of products. Love the way my skin feels and looks after use.
Great deep cleanser, goes on easy leaves my skin refreshed n clean
This mask is great. Small jar but goes a long way. It's nice smooth and rejuvenates my brown face!

I really like this charcoal mask! It has a soft consistency while very easy to blend. I use this mask twice a week and I love how refreshed my face feels afterwards. It eliminates the excess oil and cleanses deep inside my pores. Also, a little goes a long way so this product is well worth the money!

avis.titre: This mask burned skin for at least 2 days after using.
avis.texte: I used this mask exactly as the directions said. First of all, it was impossible to get completely off. I had to use a makeup remover wipe, and still not sure I got it all out of my pores. Now my skin has been burning for the last 2 days every time I put my normal products on. I have normal/oily combination skin. No sensitivity to other products. I do not recommend this.
Ahh, best charcoal facial I've used. Goes on so smooth and my skin loves this. It's a weekly treat!
I love this stuff. It makes my face so silky smooth and soft. Easy to apply and feels nice. Highly recommend!
This is the perfect makeup detox… it's important to detox our faces as well as our bodies especially if your a glam girl !!

I wanted to try out a new mask to help clear out my pores and you dont even have to take a lot onto your hands to cover your face which is nice since its a small bottle. No strong smell thankfully and my face barely felt like I had anything on it. I only used it once so far at night and when I rinsed it off I admittedly didnt feel a difference, but then in the morning when I woke up I could feel that my face felt soft. It was so nice! Will be doing it again tonight.
I love this mask! It doesn't flake and it leaves my face feeling clean with a healthy glow.
I love the charcoal detox mask! After use, my skin is super soft and look so bright and renewed.

I literally just used this mask and it is a game changer! It left my skin feeling smooth and super refreshed. I used a thin layer so taking it off was a breeze. It left no residue and when I used my rose water toner there was no trace of the mask! Followed up with the Vit C Serum and the Oil free Hyaluronic Gel Cream, normally I use the Revitalizer but I wanted to try this moisturizer. I love the way my skin feels and looks. It feels like the mask deeply cleaned out my pores and the other products complimented it very well. I love these products and the price point is spot on compared to some other products that don't do half as good as Buttah! If you are oily especially with summer time coming I recommend using the Oil free Gel Cream in the morning and the Revitalizer at night. I plan to use them this way. Thank you again for such wonderful products! My Melanin is poppin!
Unsure if the product is working but I use it once a day in the morning. Only had product less than a month

avis.titre: My Face Was BREAKING OUT Bad
avis.texte: My skin was having an absolute melt down and was co.pltely irritated and broken out for two days. I used this product followed by an antioxident essence and by morning all of the sudden acne like irritation was gone. I will be a forever loyal buyer.
Absolutely love this. It made my skin look so well balanced and clean
Applied nicely but had a burning sensation it felt very uncomfortable

After applying my buttah cleanser, I love using an ample supply of buttah's soothing clay masque that gives a slight tingle. After it dries, I rinse with hot water and my face feels as soft as a baby's face! I never forget to apply buttah's light rosewater toner and polish it off with a few drops of buttah's light oil. Let it dry then complete with non-oily moisturizer. Talk about a good night!
It has not been long enough for me to see any results. But I have confidence that I will, so I gave it a high rating.

avis.titre: Feels like I found my last skin care products
avis.texte: Such a nice feeling on my face and not sticky love this product

I just received this product and the sample skin kit. Tried to open the mask first but the cap wouldn't twist off. Eventually, I was able to open it after holding it under hot running water and using a knife. The contents so far are fine - light, and clean. Time will tell if they are as effective as described. The mask is definitely much lighter than others I've tried. However, the sample serum stopper top is not coming off easily either so I'm unable to sample it at this time. I feel I shouldn't have to struggle to open a beauty product.

avis.titre: Brighter and Cleaner skin for sure!
avis.texte: I enjoyed this mask! My skin felt brighter and cleaner after using it. It was a great add-on to the Buttah products I already use!
Not saying it's not good at all, but it's not for me. It broke my checks out into a bumoy rash.

I was using Rodan and Fields for greater than 2 years. I began to field very dry in my face and searched for something more appropriate to bring back moisture. I love this product. This one in particular delivers a smooth field and good look to my skin. It is everything,my moisture has returned . I found the perfect rhythm with the entire line. Thank you
I absolutely love this clay mask. The consistency is really nice and I love the tingly feeling when I put it on my skin. It's also not very drying.
In the few times I've used the mask, my skin is left feeling fresh and looking great. The charcoal isn't harsh on my skin, which is great because I have really sensitive skin. I am loving it so fa r

When using this product,it is transforming to my skin, and no one can quess my age. Been using for some time now, first seeing it on Facebook and happy to know I can get now at Ulta is wonderful Thanks for making this product
I've had a minor skin condition for a couple of years where certain areas of my skin flakes. Not only has this product but the other products have eliminated that minor skin flaking .
Love this mask. I can really see & feel a difference and I like that it rinse off so easily. I'm a happy customer.

I purchased this item and it didn't impress me at all. I did not see or feel that it did anything to my face. This product may work well for others, it just didn't work for me. I was not impressed with the products. I just wanted to be honest and give my experience with this product.
Great skin care line! I have already recommended it to friends and family.
First time using the product. It goes on smoothly with a slight tingle and dries rather quickly. Look forward to see the quality of the product.

I absolutely love!! It makes my skin very soft. I do not know how often I should use it though. It does not get hard like I thought it would but it washes off easily. I can definitely feel a difference in my skin by using this product.
After 2 weeks there's been a noticeable change in my skin, texture, and everything.

I purchased the charcoal detox mask with my regular essentials and when I got it and worked it into my facial routine it was instant soft skin and glowing and flowing with clear essence. I've gotten so many compliments on my amazing "glowing skin" and when I say "it's button" they don't believe! So I say try it and redeem your beauty! That detox with the cleansing kit "is FACTS!"
This is the best mask I've ever used. It goes on creamy and smooth and does not irritate my skin. Once I remove it my skin feels soft and supple.
A little goes a long way. Leaving your skin cleansed, hydrated and magnified.
A little goes a long way. My faced felt cleansed, hydrated and magnified. Noticed pore reduction immediately.
Really good product. It has left my skin feeling smooth with good hydration!
A bit complicated to rince off.l leaves a huge mess in the bathroom
I had to get use to the tingle sensation. Overall a good product.
Great product all the way around. This will be my forever product.
The Charcoal Detox Mask is one of my favs. I love the feel and the results. You don't want to miss out on how great your skin will feel after you detox with this mask.
Love this stuff! Generally will settle my skin when it is having a "fit"! Wish it was in stores!
I have seen such an incredible difference in my skin. I rarely have breakouts and if I get a pimple it doesn't leave the blemish it once left before. So happy I purchased this product.

I started using the charcoal mask in order to fully detox my skin. THIS WAS A GREAT INVESTMENT! I use this mask, with a combination of the tea tree exfoliating mask and my skin has never been clearer.
This is the best mask out there! It makes my face feel so clean and soft. I especially love it's creamy texture
This mask is incredible. I use it in combination with the toner. The consistency is perfect which makes it easy to rinse off. It is well worth the investment.
This product is very strong and exfoliate very well. I like the Teatree exfoliate her better.
I love this! After I wash it off I can see that my skin looks and feel better

This is a really great product and I could ''feel' it working almost immediately. It's a little messy to put on - as to be expected - and the same with rinsing it; however, the results are amazing. It's a quality mask that will keep your skin feeling soft and looking radiant! Definitely worth the purchase.
This charcoal mask cream makes my skin look and feel smooth and refreshed without leaving behind any residue or chemical smell.

Great product!! It's effective, but gentle on my skin. I wouldn't say I have sensitive skin but it can get slightly irritated by these types of masks, but this one didn't cause me any irritation at all.
The mask quality is great and I think I will see great improvement.

I have been using these products for almost 2 months now and I do see a huge difference in my skin. For the last few years I've struggled with finding the right products to help remove the dark spots on my face and wearing masks the last two years made it no better. The dark spots are fading and my skin has been glowing. I highly recommend!

Where has Buttah been all my life? The way this mask makes my skin feel is second to none. Coupled with the tea tree scrub, rosewater toner, and the coco moisturizer, your skin is left feel smooth and refreshed. I am absolutely in love with this line of skincare.
The Charcoal Detox Mask is amazing. The smoothness of my skin was terrific. There was minimal residue.
I use it twice a week and my ance and dark spot are clearing up nicely.
I really love this mask I use it twice a week. It just leaves my face so smooth and it makes my face come to life.

I love all of the Buttah Skin products. So glad to have tried this Charcoal Detox Mask. My skin had been looking a bit dry so I tried it. I love the texture of the product - it went on cool and smooth. After I washed off the mask - my skin looked refreshed and renewed. I highly recommend this product - like a mini facial in a jar.
I enjoy using this mask on my face. It's very easy to apply and leaves my face feeling amazing afterwards.
